g.text: C. GPU execution during tool windows, separately profiled groups
Milliseconds per task; reduced spans alone do not prove task speedup
1536-byte gate frozen before new evaluation. Later start can lose overlap; all negative task/tool/device pairs retained.
Bare results determine end-to-end effects. Per-batch token sizes / counts and marker bounds are in CSV.
No added pressure in CLI validation; default512 capacity / prefill off unchanged. Paired results in report.
